'$'''coprocSrcCode="$(echo """
local p{<#>} p{<#>}_PID

{ coproc p{<#>} {
export LC_ALL=C LANG=C IFS= FORKRUN_TMPDIR=\"${tmpDir}\"

echo \"\${BASH_PID}\" >\"${tmpDir}\"/.run/p{<#>}

trap ''': >\"${tmpDir}\"/.quit, 
[[ -f \"${tmpDir}\"/.run/' (123,946 us, 0.00%)

'$'''trap '''trap - TERM INT HUP USR1, 
 returnVal=1, 
 kill -USR1 $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null), 
 kill -INT $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null) '''"${PID0}" INT' (150,018 us, 0.01%)
'trap - EXIT INT TERM HUP USR1' (100,569 us, 0.00%)

'$'''trap '''trap - TERM INT HUP USR1, 
 returnVal=1, 
 kill -USR1 $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null), 
 kill -TERM $(cat </dev/null "'''"${tmpDir}"'''"/.run/p* 2>/dev/null) '''"${PID0}" TERM' (296,750 us, 0.01%)
